fields.statement: Built rhiza from 3d6baba6c (go build -trimpath) and ran it in a hermetic scratch root and repo (env -i, own HOME, project added, a held 'hold' wait-step run giving RHIZA_RUN): `rhiza run findings - --json` heredoc with an uncovered-intent finding on cap-a and an oversized-leaf on cap-b recorded round 1, f1 and f2, both severity major; a no-failure-case finding was refused exit 2 listing the seven kinds ending uncovered-intent, oversized-leaf; after a verdict confirming f2, `rhiza run review-check` exited 1 naming f2 oversized-leaf on cap-b.

Built rhiza from 3d6baba6c (go build -trimpath) and ran it in a hermetic scratch root and repo (env -i, own HOME, project added, a held 'hold' wait-step run giving RHIZA_RUN): `rhiza guide plan-critic` prints the six sections in order, Read first names `rhiza run status --json`, the verdict heredoc with confirmed, downgraded+severity and dropped, never add/raise rules and severities, command-budget, never and session-done blocks expanded, no findings heredoc or rhiza apply; its verdict heredoc ran as written (`rhiza run verdict - --json`) with f1 downgraded to minor and f2 confirmed, and run status showed 'downgraded from major to minor'.

Built rhiza from 3d6baba6c (go build -trimpath) and ran it in a hermetic scratch root and repo (env -i, own HOME, project added, a held 'hold' wait-step run giving RHIZA_RUN): `rhiza guide plan-reviewer` prints the six sections in order, the seven kinds incl. uncovered-intent and oversized-leaf, the vague-acceptance and codebase-assumption rules, `rhiza overlaps`, never recording what rhiza check reports, the empty-round rule and the severities/command-budget/never/session-done blocks expanded, no verdict or apply; its findings heredoc ran as written (`rhiza run findings - --json`) and journalled round 1.

Built rhiza from 3d6baba6c (go build -trimpath) and ran it in a hermetic scratch root and repo (env -i, own HOME, project added, a held 'hold' wait-step run giving RHIZA_RUN): `rhiza guide plan-reviser` prints the six sections in order, `rhiza apply <file> --change <cs> --json` and `--record`, the split-oversized-leaf and leaf-for-uncovered-clause rules, confirmed-major-only, never-invent-a-quote, and the command-budget/never/session-done blocks expanded, with no findings or verdict heredoc.

Built rhiza from 3d6baba6c (go build -trimpath) and ran it in a hermetic scratch root and repo (env -i, own HOME, project added, a held 'hold' wait-step run giving RHIZA_RUN): `rhiza guide planner` prints Task, Expected outcome, Read first, Must do, Must not do, Context in order; Read first names plan-recipes and plan-interview and the research pass (rhiza why, searching the intent's names, files each leaf touches); Must do ends in the self-check (rhiza slice, intent clauses served, one concern, provenance, depends-on, rhiza check); autonomous runs in Context. `rhiza guide ls` lists planner (823), plan-recipes (746), plan-interview (646) as topics.

Built rhiza from 3d6baba6c (go build -trimpath) and ran it in a hermetic scratch root and repo (env -i, own HOME, project added, a held 'hold' wait-step run giving RHIZA_RUN): `rhiza guide ls` lists planner, plan-reviewer, plan-critic, plan-reviser; `rhiza guide install --agent claude --json` wrote skills/rhiza-planner, rhiza-plan-reviewer, rhiza-plan-critic, rhiza-plan-reviser SKILL.md beside rhiza-plan (rhiza-plan-critic frontmatter carries the topic's description), and a second install listed all of them unchanged, written empty; `rhiza guide plan` and `plan-review` print short indexes naming the role topics with /rhiza-<topic> and `rhiza guide <topic>` routes.

Built rhiza from 3d6baba6c (go build -trimpath) and ran it in a hermetic scratch root and repo (env -i, own HOME, project added, a held 'hold' wait-step run giving RHIZA_RUN): `rhiza workflow describe plan` shows the interview, review, critic and revise prompts as the four one-liners (/rhiza-planner ... follow rhiza guide planner., /rhiza-plan-reviewer ..., /rhiza-plan-critic ..., /rhiza-plan-reviser ...) with no session done text.

Built rhiza from 3d6baba6c (go build -trimpath) and ran it in a hermetic scratch root and repo (env -i, own HOME, project added, a held 'hold' wait-step run giving RHIZA_RUN): `rhiza guide plan-reviewer`, `plan-critic` and `review` each print the expanded Severities section; the plan-review mapping names missing-acceptance, contradiction, outside-intent, uncovered-intent and oversized-leaf major, matching run findings' severity output for the new kinds.
